title.narrative: Building an environment of peace and "buen vivir" with ethnic communities in Chocó

description.narrative: The project will benefit social and ethnic territorial organisations in the department of Chocó, served by the Social Pastoral of the Diocese of Quibdó and the AfroColombian community council COCOMOPOCA. Its main objective is to strengthen the appropriation of the territorial reality and the culture of peace in the territories and ethnic authorities, through collective actions aimed at overcoming poverty, sustainable development, the environment, local governance, healthy coexistence and reconciliation. The project aims to achieve three results: 1) Support for the community strengthening processes of COCOMOPOCA, the processes of the Community Action Councils (JACs) supported by the Pastoral Social. 2) Productive enterprises with women and young people have been promoted, focusing on the creation of added value, entrepreneurial culture and innovation. 3) Strengthened institutional capacity for an integral and effective management of the strategic plan of COCOMOPOCA and the Pastoral Social, within the scope of the legal, advocacy and administrative components and accompaniment of the Peace Process in Colombia
